prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop landing page UI concept for Izge, edge-to-edge landscape 1536x1024, crisp readable interface text, no browser frame, device or desk. This concept deliberately uses familiar premium software website structure, implemented with exceptional restraint. Izge connects company records to reveal overlooked work, obligations and next actions, with private assistant and team collaboration. A company buyer must understand it and try the demo. Navigation: Izge wordmark, Product, How it works, EN / TR, Try demo. A concise introductory headline 'Your company knows more than it remembers.' One sentence: 'Izge connects the evidence, surfaces what matters, and brings it back to your team.' Primary action 'Try demo'; secondary 'Explore a discovery'. Underneath, one large believable product workspace, not a feature card grid. The active view is a source-backed finding '18 hours missing from the invoice' with '₺36,000 + VAT / Potential billing to review' and clearly readable 'Demo scenario · Subject to commercial approval'. Source evidence: contract at ₺2,000 per hour, delivery record of 18 hours, invoice listing maintenance only. Include Open source and Discuss with team controls. Sidebar names Team chat, Izge chat, Memory, Findings. The next section starts with a compact team response and source preview. Cool white and graphite, restrained blue action color, confident sans typography and immaculate spacing. Avoid invented testimonials, customer logos, metrics, autonomous money recovery claims and decorative 3D objects.
Use Atlas as the demo company. No invented integration logos or names. Source excerpt metadata is September 2026, invoice PUS-2026-0918, maintenance ₺85,000. Delivery entries are 6 hours address correction, 4 hours validation, 8 hours historical record cleanup. No photographic people or office scene; only flat website UI.
notes: Concept only. Generated names, dialogue and secondary metadata remain illustrative, not shipped product claims.
